title: Bar Timeline: Market Time vs Collection Time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  $__time(timestamp) as time,
  CONCAT('BAR TIME - ', vendor, ' - ', symbol) as series,
  volume as value
FROM intg_one_minute_live_polygon 
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  $__time(received_at) as time,
  CONCAT('COLLECTION TIME - ', vendor, ' - ', symbol) as series,
  volume as value
FROM intg_one_minute_live_polygon
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  $__time(timestamp) as time,
  CONCAT('BAR TIME - ', vendor, ' - ', symbol) as series,
  volume as value
FROM intg_one_minute_live_tiingo 
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  $__time(received_at) as time,
  CONCAT('COLLECTION TIME - ', vendor, ' - ', symbol) as series,
  volume as value
FROM intg_one_minute_live_tiingo
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
ORDER BY 1,2
